author: NICKGERR69
quote:
Rating: -10/10 Grand Theft Auto VI is a massive disappointment that feels nothing like an actual GTA game. Calling this "Grand Theft Auto" is an insult to the franchise when you cannot even steal highend cars or keep the vehicles you jack without grinding for multiple hours through the story just to unlock Key Cloner and tracker removal.

Instead of an authentic crime experience, the narrative feels like a total cuck simulator centered around an unbearable protagonist in Lucia. The writing comes across as pure woke goy slop that completely ruins the immersion and strips away the edge that made previous games iconic.

The core gameplay mechanics are equally frustrating. Both the gunplay and the driving feel terrible clunky, unresponsive, and a huge step backward. Literally the only redeeming quality in this entire package is the graphics. If you completely ignore the story and strictly treat the game as a mindless sandbox, it might **** by as a 7/10 at best, but as a mainline GTA title, it is an absolute failure.

I fully expect Take-Two to send goons and a hitman straight to my house. Save your money. JUST DONT BUT IT
